senses.gloss: (Syr. נחל, P. Sm. 2336; cmp. נְהֵי I) to shake, sift (cmp.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 29b:5">Bets. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>דביתהו … נַהֲלָא וכ׳</he> the wife of R. J. sifted flour (on the Holy Day) on the back of &c., v. <cite ref="M00353"><he>מְהוּלְתָּא</he> I</cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>נְהִיל</he>, <cite ref="N00262"><he>נְהִילָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 51b">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite>. <he>קטמא נ׳</he> sifted ashes (which bake and harden when piled up).
<cite ref="Taanit 9b">Taan. 9ᵇ</cite> (<he>עיבא</he>) <he>נ׳</he> ‘a sifted cloud’, a form of light and scattered clouds.
